name: The Plain Price
description: A trader asks six coins for grain with no persuasion cue.
claim: I have grain to sell. Buy one grain from me for six coins.

evidence.fact: The market ledger sets the usual price of grain at two coins and records no order, deadline or agreement tied to this sale.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} paid {{price}} coins for one grain against a two-coin price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: The ledger sets the usual price at two coins. The resident refused the inflated price.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. The price was refused without checking the ledger.
